description: Mi TV Stick 4K (Android TV 11, no Wireless debugging menu), USB debugging on, adbd on TCP 5555: the answer to a PTR query for _adb._tcp. The host is Android-3.local: mDNS renamed it because other boxes on the LAN already hold Android.local. Captured 2026-10-27; serial, IPv4 and IPv6 (EUI-64, carries the MAC) replaced byte-for-byte with neutral values of the same length.
